annotation.title_clean: Guidance on privacy and developing and training generative AI models
annotation.title_en: Guidance on privacy and developing and training generative AI models
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)
annotation.summary_en: OAIC guidance for developers of generative AI models subject to the Australian Privacy Act, offering a checklist on training-data accuracy, privacy by design, privacy impact assessments, lawful collection, consent, secondary use, scraped data and transparency under the Australian Privacy Principles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Developers must ensure training data accuracy and communicate model limitations
Adopt privacy by design and complete privacy impact assessments
Collection must be lawful and fair; consent needed for sensitive information
Scraped data must comply with privacy obligations; assess provenance of third-party data
APP 5 notices and privacy policies must clearly explain use of data for AI
